about: Package 3c (the instruments of YuE2 and MiniMax-Music3: Build by section, Continue from recording, the Lead sheet and its score preview, and what the Flow renderer, Plans & endings, Re-planning, Plan adherence and Throughput still lacked): every scenario this package makes runnable, each with what it exercises. 36-instruments-3c.mjs holds on the concept page too (--page hotstep-tiers.html), except its last two, which are the concept's pending E-46 and E-47 stated in full. Entries marked `waiting` need a package built in parallel (4: the prompt card; 6: Latest's songs and generation). `excluded` lists the concept's scenarios that exercise these instruments and cannot pass as written, each with why.

scenarios.why: buildBoard and the build session: empty it offers Plan the score, Planning while the planner writes, the sections in their colours, focus on to making takes (E-09), Generate N takes, the takes landing with waveform, length, play, discard and Keep, More takes; planning one step, the takes arriving none; picking a section no step.

buildBoard: Keep a step named for take and section, the keep stays on its card and checks its section with Next (B-37), Follow score and Plan strength locked as read-outs with a padlock, keyboard-reachable (E-25, E-31), said once; Discard a step with Undo in its toast; letting go of a keep a step that frees the locks.

buildBoard: Render N of M sections, Render saves the song and keeps the build (B-06), Rendered as, Render again and Start a new build; Render a step that Undo takes back leaving the keep; Start a new build a step that Undo puts back whole.

buildBoard: keeps belong to a named section (B-05), a keep sung to old words flagged on its tab and in the banner (E-26), a new section hatched, the banner with one Re-plan and Keep building, Re-plan naming its cost before the press (E-04), Keep building a step.
Build by section's strips: no tagged lyrics offers tags that open the board; Chain of Thought off folds it to a strip as wide as the tile (E-19) whose way out turns it on.

recordingSpan: a drag inside carries the part, an edge moves that edge, a barely-moving click changes nothing, a drag outside draws a new part of at most 30 s (G-B-01), a double-click puts back the first 20 s, each drag one step named in the recording's times; its caption and aria value text.

abcFoot and the score preview: the foot's actions as they apply, the preview opening on a planned score with seed and verdict and focus on its way on, Tab round the dialog, Escape back to the button, a runaway plan drawn as it plays (E-23, B-47), the trail playing from a section with the playhead on its system (E-01), Stop, Insert example counted, the pasted sheet previewed as written and downloaded by title, text that is not ABC said (E-26).
abcFoot with Chain of Thought off: says the Planner writes nothing down and offers the way back, which hands focus to the preview (E-12).

The lead sheet's lyric-timing line (the .ctl-row a choice and its notes make): what Hard does and that it needs composer CFG 1, the warning at once in the warning's ink with Set CFG to auto (B-09), nothing while Off.
The Flow renderer's knobs and switches in one row (.flow-row, D-11).
buildBoard's Play kept (pending E-46 in the concept, stated in full): every keep in section order, the section playing lit and its card playing, a second press stops.
recordingSpan's play button (pending E-47 in the concept, stated in full): the playhead runs across the chosen part in its own time and stops at its end.
Pending E-09 in the concept, now passing: Build's button names the takes it will make on every step of Takes per section.
Pending E-24 in the concept, now passing: discarding the last kept take frees Follow score and Plan strength (the locks are worked out from the keeps).
Pending E-23 in the concept, now passing: a recording chosen brings focus to its waveform, and a toast says what was loaded with Undo.
Pending E-46 in the concept, now passing: Play kept beside Render (its behaviour in 36-instruments-3c/build-plays-the-kept-takes-in-order).
Pending E-47 in the concept, now passing: Continue's play button (its behaviour in 36-instruments-3c/recording-plays-its-chosen-part).

buildBoard: focus on making takes once planned (E-09), Re-plan's cost before the press and what it dropped after (E-04), Undo bringing the takes back, a keep locking Follow score reachable by keyboard and its release unlocking (E-25), a keep sung to old words flagged with one Re-plan (E-26).
buildBoard at each tier (E-19): Quick sections, takes and Render without settings; Studio section mode and takes; Lab Follow score, Plan strength and the seed.
buildBoard: a locked value and its label at full strength (E-31).

Build by section's strip at Quick names Studio in its Also set line for Takes per section (E-25): a strip says what is set elsewhere, and the tier its settings are in is where its face edits them, strip or not.
recordingSpan's keys (B-28): End, Home, Page Up; the ruler's round steps ending on the file's length.
recordingSpan: loading the recording is a step (E-23), a key on the selection a step named in the recording's times, Ctrl+Z puts back only the selection.

The score preview: planned with its seed and focus on Continue, Tab kept in the dialog, Retry, Download, Play becoming Stop, the playhead on the first system (E-01), a section played from the trail, Stop; Insert example, the pasted sheet previewed and downloaded, Close, the lyric-timing line.

waiting.because: It writes the prompt into the prompt card's #prompt (package 4) before it presses Continue with this score; every check before that passes, and Continue now queues the run with its seed (package 6's generate, registered through scoreRuns: checked by hand).

scenarios.why: abcFoot with Chain of Thought off and the way back focusing the preview (E-12), a full lead sheet's chord symbols and its capitalised title, Melody only without chords, text that is not ABC said (E-26).

waiting.because: It writes the style into the prompt card's #prompt (package 4) for the score's title; its first two checks pass.

excluded.why: It clicks the tile strip's [data-tag] and [data-bcot] hooks and the planner's [data-seg="lm.cotmode"][data-v="Off"] (deviation 10: the rebuild's strip buttons and choices run their own actions), and reads the rendered song from S.songs (package 6). Its build checks are in 36-instruments-3c (build-strip-offers-the-way-on, build-render-keeps-the-build, build-follows-new-lyrics) and 15-other-engines/build-replan-and-locks; its reload check passes here up to S.songs.

Its first check also needs the planner's composer CFG token painted .clash by the lead sheet (the concept's cross-module paint hook, paintCfgClash; deviation 10), which is not built (notes); the line, its warning and its fix are checked in 36-instruments-3c/lyric-timing-says-what-it-needs.
The Flow renderer's Play while rendering is a run's (package 6: the rendering card and the player); the switch itself is drawn.
Package 2's exclusion stands: it reads the concept's [data-mmcache] paint hook (deviation 10) and the Endings switches' tips (the LED switch's tip, package 3b).

Package 2's exclusion stands: it picks a YuE2 solver by its label (data-opt, deviation 10) and switches Plan adherence's groups by the concept's [data-adpow]/[data-adg] hooks; the groups' power chips are in 33-containers/rack-groups-switch-and-stand-back.
